analysis:
The only change in this PR is a documentation edit at docs/provider/cli-reference.md line 2183 (head). It extends the `[backend] enabled_models` table row to say that, when set, the list also bounds coordinator model commands and rollouts, and it links to the configuration reference. The supplied units are base excerpts at lines 386-1226, so they do not include the changed line. I used the patch excerpt, which is complete, to confirm the change is a single-line text edit with no code, config default or mode change.

The edit is a documentation clarification and adds no attack surface. If anything it describes a tighter operator-side filter on coordinator-initiated model commands. It does not alter TB-002 (coordinator-provider WebSocket), TB-007, TB-011 or TB-012/013 behavior, and it makes no new claims about attestation, App Attest authorization, prefix-cache storage (T-041) or logout revocation (A-008, T-053).

The surrounding base text covers logout/revoke, sandbox installer download (TB-013/T-061), add-on hold (TB-012) and Autopilot. None of it is modified here. Unverified: the claim that `enabled_models` bounds coordinator model commands and rollouts depends on provider code that is not in the supplied evidence, including the linked configuration.md#provider-model-selection section and the Autopilot/switch handling. This PR cannot establish that behavior, and a doc-vs-code mismatch would be a docs-accuracy matter rather than a regression introduced here. No threat-model update is needed from this PR alone.
